scope: Explore remaining delays in field confirmation, first estimates, and saving video. No production behavior changed in this investigation.
followup: Implemented and verified in docs/responsive-save-implementation.json. The bundled FFmpeg build successfully uses Intel Quick Sync; the system-binary probe failures recorded below no longer describe the app's active encoder path.

hardware_observed.cpu: Intel Celeron J3355, 2 cores / 2 logical processors
hardware_observed.qsv_default_and_dxva2_probes: Both timed out; hardware encoding is not demonstrated usable.

findings.cause: Confirmation awaits html2canvas rasterization of the satellite map before closing. Coordinates are already computed. This is screenshot work, not a database save of the hit.
options: Commit coordinates and proceed immediately; make image capture independent of navigation using a frozen map snapshot.
Reuse a base-map image for unchanged view bounds, then draw updated markers without recapturing tiles.
Preload local JS assets and map tiles where permitted; avoid repeated CORS image requests.
Bound screenshot loading time; retain explicit missing-image status rather than block geometry confirmation.
findings.measurement_limit: Isolated-browser live-map test could not reach its readiness condition within 90 seconds. No clean live screenshot duration is claimed.

findings.cause: Browser abort does not propagate cancellation to the server estimator. A single serial estimator queue retains obsolete work, including work that has outlived a response timeout.
options: Use explicit cancellable jobs with a request generation and cooperative checks between hypotheses.
Coalesce pending requests for the same workflow so only the newest input runs.
Reuse a running job only for identical evidence; rerun acceptance separately for a changed distance.
Discard stale responses on both client and server.
findings.verification: Code-level finding; no production job was killed for this investigation.

findings.cause: Fresh staged fit evaluates roughly 125 geometric hypotheses and thousands of trial flights in Python. Prior output-point reduction and unchanged-evidence caching help but do not eliminate the first search.
options: Move the flight integration loop into a compiled kernel while retaining the same equations and timestep; verify against raw marks and the current implementation.
Cache camera calibration separately from flight fitting, keyed by field size, video dimensions, landmarks, camera and contact registration.
Use a coarse-to-fine search or trajectory-table index to seed exact refinement, with explicit checks that the best solution and uncertainty range are not lost.
Show a labeled preliminary result while sensitivity variants finish; do not silently present it as a completed confidence range.
Move fresh fitting to a stronger dedicated worker if local performance remains insufficient.
findings.accuracy_constraint: Keep early-angle/later-height constraints and later observations; speed must not come from silently dropping evidence.

findings.cause: Each new export process probes Quick Sync again. The probe is cached only within that process; on this machine it currently times out and falls back to software.
options: Probe once in a warm worker and pass the verified encoder choice into render jobs.
Cache failed capabilities with an expiry and invalidate on executable/driver/device changes.
Troubleshoot an appropriate Intel encoder implementation separately, preserving a working software fallback.

findings.cause: Up to eight chunk workers plus per-encoder threads compete on a two-core local CPU. Static cards are encoded repeatedly and animated frames are composed in Python/OpenCV.
options: Benchmark a bounded worker/thread budget rather than assuming more workers are faster.
Reuse unchanged encoded sections: source replay, map, statistics and flight animation have different invalidation keys.
Reduce repeated full-frame copies and move supported overlays/compositing into FFmpeg.
Use a faster encoding preset or lower export resolution only after quality comparison.
Offer shorter output or a smaller quick-share variant as an explicit product choice.
Explore browser WebCodecs/GPU composition or a dedicated render worker for larger architectural gains.
findings.measurement_limit: Worker-count alternatives were inspected, not freshly benchmarked end to end. Earlier render results were not treated as current tests.

findings.cause: Save-hit still probes and re-encodes a separate seven-second source clip before inserting the source and rendered MP4 blobs. The annotated render can be reused, but this extra source encoding remains on the save path.
options: Prepare the reusable source clip earlier or defer it after durable save acknowledgement.
Keep the original source once and store trim bounds when the consuming workflow supports it.
Reuse matching frame-accurate source clips across EV/swing/pitch preparation.
Measure actual database transaction and blob-copy cost before changing storage.
Consider file/object storage plus database metadata if measured large-video storage costs justify a migration.
findings.accuracy_constraint: Do not replace accurate source trimming with unvalidated keyframe-only stream copying; contact timing must remain correct.

recommended_order: Remove the screenshot from field confirmation's critical path.
Avoid repeated failed encoder probes and move extra source-copy encoding out of the download wait.
Benchmark render worker/thread settings and section reuse.
Compile the fresh-fit integration kernel and cache camera calibration.
Evaluate dedicated-server or browser/GPU processing if local performance still misses the target.
requirements_for_followup_benchmarks: Use the same current raw Cortland evidence; run alternatives sequentially; record first-run and reuse timings separately; preserve frame/contact alignment, all reviewed points, metric equivalence, export readability and both manual/automatic workflows. Do not use saved predictions as ground truth for inference.
